comment: Whether to enforce configured limits on GraphQL query input size.
modal: When **Yes**, the configured GraphQL input limits are enforced, rejecting queries that exceed them. A safeguard against overly large or abusive queries. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether to enforce a maximum number of field aliases in a GraphQL query.
modal: When **Yes**, GraphQL queries using more than the allowed number of aliases are rejected, limiting a known request-amplification technique. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether to enforce a maximum character length for GraphQL queries.
modal: When **Yes**, GraphQL queries longer than the allowed character count are rejected. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: Whether to disable PHP session handling for GraphQL requests.
modal: When **Yes**, GraphQL requests are served without starting a PHP session, which can improve performance for stateless API traffic.

comment: Whether dynamically-defined attributes are exposed as fields on their entity types in the GraphQL schema.
modal: When **Yes**, dynamic (store-defined) attributes appear as typed fields on their entity in the GraphQL schema rather than only through generic containers. Can be set per website or store view.
